parts.title: Into the Woods
parts.text: Wren, Isaac, and Mei went on a bird watching walk with a notebook and a pair of binoculars. The path was soft and **mossy**, and the tall trees began to **sway** in the breeze. Mei picked up a blue **feather** from the ground. “A bird must have dropped this,” she said.

parts.title: The Nest
parts.text: Isaac heard a bird **warble** a sweet song high above them. They looked up and saw a nest in the branches. The mother bird was busy trying to **weave** one more **twig** into its side. Three **speckled** eggs sat inside, and the mother would **nestle** down over them to keep them warm.

parts.title: A Little Surprise
parts.text: A week later, the children came back and saw one egg starting to **hatch**. By summer, a young **fledgling** stood on the edge of the nest, flapping its wings. A **tuft** of soft fluff still stuck up on its head. Nearby, the mother bird began to **preen**, smoothing her wing with her beak.

parts.title: Quiet and Patient
parts.text: The children said goodbye to the little bird. Isaac wrote in his notebook, “Be quiet and patient, and nature will show you wonderful things.” Mei agreed. They walked home, already planning their next trip.
